artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a distinct band of nonsensical, garbled text at the bottom ('CANNBB...'). This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model attempts to render text but fails to produce legible characters.
The red stitching lacks the precise, raised 3D structure of real thread. In many areas, the stitches appear painted on or slightly melted into the leather surface, lacking individual definition.
Where the balls touch, the boundaries sometimes blur or merge slightly, rather than showing sharp contact shadows and distinct edges. Some seams seem to terminate abruptly or fade out unnaturally.
